aiResearchSummary.text: Crossbeam is researching systems and methods of determining partner influence and systems and methods of contextual record reporting to support ecosystem led growth. The work focuses on receiving and analyzing activity and population data across partners, identifying overlapping records, and quantifying how partner interactions influence accounts. Together, these efforts advance influence attribution and contextual data reporting within partner ecosystems.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series C round raised $76,000,000, or 65.04% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $12,020,741 to $598,569,976, a 49.79x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 50 (+2 over 90 days) and market heat at 62 (+0).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
